desc: DONE offline: corrected the premise—generic Linux s2idle is entered through cpuidle; macsmc-input only supplies lid/power hard wake events (fixed by upstream 56269d58), not an SMC sleep command. Current cpuidle-apple saves x18-x30, unconditionally touches locked CYC_OVRD, and executes WFI; its allowlist ends at T6034. Merely adding T6040 would conflict with this rig's proven WFI/WFIT state loss, m1n1 broken_wfi=true/SLEEP_NONE, and required idle=nop. With idle=nop and no T6040 driver, s2idle only spins and gives no useful residency. Defined the required upstream T6040 retention contract and staged cpuidle, SMC-wake, then RAM-root s2idle order. No rig/MMIO/SMC write proposed. Result: done/2026-07-24-t6040-suspend-feasibility.md.
